deuce.m: A tie in tennis or table tennis that requires winning two successive points to win the game.

deuces.m: A tie in tennis or table tennis that requires winning two successive points to win the game.

deuteranopia.m: Dichromacy characterised by a lowered sensitivity to green light resulting in an inability to distinguish green and purplish-red.

deuteranopias.m: Dichromacy characterised by a lowered sensitivity to green light resulting in an inability to distinguish green and purplish-red.

deuteranopic.m: Inability to see the colour green or to distinguish green and purplish-red.

deuterium.m: An isotope of hydrogen which has one neutron (as opposed to zero neutrons in hydrogen).

deuteron.m: The nucleus of deuterium; consists of one proton and one neutron; used as a bombarding particle in accelerators.

deuterons.m: The nucleus of deuterium; consists of one proton and one neutron; used as a bombarding particle in accelerators.

deutzia.m: Any of various shrubs of the genus Deutzia having usually toothed opposite leaves and shredding bark and white or pink flowers in loose terminal clusters.

deutzias.m: Any of various shrubs of the genus Deutzia having usually toothed opposite leaves and shredding bark and white or pink flowers in loose terminal clusters.
